intro.title: 5 Daily Habits That Ruin Your Focus
intro.text: Some habits quietly destroy your concentration without you noticing.

slides.title: 📱 PHONE CHECKING
slides.text: Checking your phone every few minutes destroys deep focus before it even begins.

slides.title: 🔔 CONSTANT NOTIFICATIONS
slides.text: Every ping forces your brain to switch context, making simple work take much longer.

slides.title: 🌙 POOR SLEEP
slides.text: When sleep is consistently low, attention, memory and decision-making all suffer.

slides.title: 🧠 MULTITASKING
slides.text: Doing several things at once feels productive, but your brain is repeatedly paying a switching cost.

slides.title: 🍩 SUGAR CRASHES
slides.text: Quick sugar gives a short spike of energy, then leaves you foggy and distracted.
